portions.purpose: Render the shared quality-review skill into Codex projects.
portions.objective: Install every Council operating role on its callable runtime path.
portions.simpler_alternative: Document the role without rendering it.
portions.necessity: A documented but absent skill cannot participate in the Council loop.

portions.purpose: Render the shared simplification skill into Codex projects.
portions.objective: Make final code-necessity review callable in Codex.
portions.simpler_alternative: Reference an uninstalled skill.
portions.necessity: The simplification gate requires an actual runtime skill.

portions.purpose: Render the governing incremental execution skill into Codex projects.
portions.objective: Make slice-by-slice execution and local commits enforceable.
portions.simpler_alternative: Leave execution discipline only in Council prose.
portions.necessity: The user requires this skill to govern execution directly.

portions.purpose: Render objective-focused interview guidance into Codex projects.
portions.objective: Prevent low-impact questions from consuming the delivery loop.
portions.simpler_alternative: Rely on generic questioning behavior.
portions.necessity: The Council calls this role before material clarifications.

portions.purpose: Render mandatory phase/item planning into Codex projects.
portions.objective: Run graph-bound planning before every execution unit.
portions.simpler_alternative: Inline planning instructions repeatedly.
portions.necessity: One shared skill prevents divergent phase and item contracts.

portions.purpose: Render graph-bound test guidance into Codex projects.
portions.objective: Require functional, quality and regression proof for every edge.
portions.simpler_alternative: Accept generic green test claims.
portions.necessity: Stable test IDs need an installed authoring contract.

portions.purpose: Resolve Council storage and persist assessed DEFER_RUN findings.
portions.objective: Keep nonblocking work durable without losing the macro path.
portions.simpler_alternative: Keep deferred findings only in chat prose.
portions.necessity: Compaction or reviewer changes would otherwise discard accepted pending work.

portions.purpose: Reject read-only writes and replay validated Council transitions.
portions.objective: Persist only legal writable state with repository-bound evidence.
portions.simpler_alternative: Let append and transition trust folder names or declared status.
portions.necessity: Independent probes reproduced direct read-only mutation and fabricated transitions.

portions.purpose: Inventory schemas, skill roles and semantic contract markers.
portions.objective: Reject generated runtimes missing a required Council dependency.
portions.simpler_alternative: Check only that Council SKILL.md exists.
portions.necessity: A wrapper can exist while its called skills or schemas are absent.

portions.purpose: Define lifecycle states, test mapping and graph-bound review decisions.
portions.objective: Prevent invented blockers and illegal review shortcuts.
portions.simpler_alternative: Trust reviewer severity and graph flags.
portions.necessity: A forged node previously produced a critical blocker with score 100.

portions.purpose: Enforce remote authority and ordered plan/slice/validation transitions.
portions.objective: Make every edit follow graph-bound planning and executed tests.
portions.simpler_alternative: Store unordered booleans for completed gates.
portions.necessity: A transition reducer prevents skipping planning, validation or local commit.

portions.purpose: Close quality, simplification, adversarial and delivery states with reviewer lineage.
portions.objective: Require every correction to re-enter a fresh planned and committed slice.
portions.simpler_alternative: Let a review verdict advance directly to delivery.
portions.necessity: Fresh correction proof and independent identities are explicit user requirements.

portions.purpose: Build real Git repositories and execute persisted Council slices across processes.
portions.objective: Test repository ancestry, lifecycle resume and manifest construction without mocked SHAs.
portions.simpler_alternative: Use in-memory dictionaries and fabricated commits.
portions.necessity: Git ancestry and process-bound replay require real repositories.

portions.purpose: Define read-only, trivial and correction-heavy start-to-goal journeys.
portions.objective: Prove representative Council paths remain traversable.
portions.simpler_alternative: Test only a single happy path.
portions.necessity: Read-only, remote authority and repeated correction have distinct failure modes.

portions.purpose: Capture worktree baseline and manage writable/read-only session lifecycle.
portions.objective: Bind all later proof to the initial repository state without audit writes.
outputs: active state files or inline read-only result
portions.simpler_alternative: Capture HEAD only when delivery begins.
portions.necessity: Late capture cannot distinguish user changes from Council drift.

portions.purpose: Validate strict nested objects and dependent schema requirements locally.
portions.objective: Reject malformed Council evidence without a new runtime dependency.
portions.simpler_alternative: Repeat ad-hoc field checks in each command.
portions.necessity: Central validation prevents schema behavior from drifting between entrypoints.

portions.purpose: Classify executable source and calculate evidence-structured weighted impact.
portions.objective: Block only real macro-critical issues and include generated templates in provenance.
portions.simpler_alternative: Accept reviewer labels and free-form evidence.
portions.necessity: Self-assigned severity and ignored .jinja drift reproduced false gates and stale receipts.

portions.purpose: Validate complete execution graphs and persist nonblocking findings.
portions.objective: Keep every critical branch connected while allowing low-impact work to continue.
portions.simpler_alternative: Use a linear checklist and chat-only pending notes.
portions.necessity: A checklist misses disconnected branches; chat does not preserve deferrals.

portions.purpose: Verify bounded code portions, source markers and nontrivial commands against Git blobs.
portions.objective: Prove every added executable line has a granular behavioral justification.
outputs: covered-line and command counts or rejection
portions.simpler_alternative: Accept whole-file prose or no-op commands.
portions.necessity: Those alternatives previously passed without proving necessity.

portions.purpose: Assert schemas, operating skills and dual-runtime role markers.
portions.objective: Prevent a referenced skill from being absent or semantically empty.
portions.simpler_alternative: Assert one generated filename.
portions.necessity: Invocation contracts span content, schema and both runtime paths.

portions.purpose: Regress writable lifecycle, read-only zero-write and corrupt-state fail-closed behavior.
portions.objective: Keep session anchoring safe under normal, audit and tampered states.
portions.simpler_alternative: Inspect session code manually.
portions.necessity: Zero-write and corruption claims require filesystem assertions.

portions.purpose: Build delivery fixtures and regress semantic review and graph bindings.
portions.objective: Reject negative review evidence, forged markers and fabricated phase nodes.
portions.simpler_alternative: Check only that referenced files exist.
portions.necessity: Existence alone accepted a historical CORRIGIR review as approval.

portions.purpose: Regress read-only immutability and durable planning deferrals.
portions.objective: Prevent audit writes while preserving nonblocking work in writable runs.
portions.simpler_alternative: Trust mutation-mode documentation.
portions.necessity: Both direct transition and append bypasses were reproduced.

portions.purpose: Regress integration order, unrecorded code, merge resolution, Jinja provenance and command replay.
portions.objective: Bind delivery to every executable commit and actual validation command.
portions.simpler_alternative: Inspect first-parent commits and declared exit codes.
portions.necessity: That approach missed merge resolutions, templates and failed replay.

portions.purpose: Regress missing graph evidence, CLI materialization and invalid ledger transitions.
portions.objective: Prove the installed public entrypoints compose all safety checks.
portions.simpler_alternative: Call internal validators independently.
portions.necessity: The installed CLI is the user-facing composition point.

portions.purpose: Regress consumption of the real transition ledger by delivery.
portions.objective: Prove producer and consumer use the same persisted evidence.
portions.simpler_alternative: Use separate synthetic ledgers for each test.
portions.necessity: Separate fixtures cannot prove the documented producer-consumer path.

portions.purpose: Define runtime fixtures and regress lifecycle ordering, review identity and correction entry.
portions.objective: Make planning, validation, commit and review ordering deterministic.
portions.simpler_alternative: Use one end-to-end scenario only.
portions.necessity: Focused failures provide precise diagnostics for each gate.

portions.purpose: Regress fresh commits, review rounds, remote authority, impact binding and test IDs.
portions.objective: Prevent stale proof, fake blockers and unauthorized remote actions.
portions.simpler_alternative: Trust reviewer flags and remote intent prose.
portions.necessity: Those inputs are precisely where reproduced bypasses occurred.

portions.purpose: Regress structured impact, weighted boundaries, graph reachability, deferral and Jinja staleness.
portions.objective: Keep macro severity and executable-source coverage deterministic.
portions.simpler_alternative: Test only one representative score.
portions.necessity: Thresholds, graph branches, persistence and source suffixes fail independently.

portions.purpose: Regress granular necessity coverage, false markers, no-op commands and oversized portions.
portions.objective: Ensure the final line report proves rather than asserts necessity.
outputs: coverage result or precise integrity failure
portions.simpler_alternative: Check only that every line number appears in a range.
portions.necessity: Mechanical ranges previously accepted vague whole-file claims.

portions.purpose: Inject macro-impact control into the English adversarial reviewer.
portions.objective: Assess only critical/high findings before blocking execution.
portions.simpler_alternative: Leave the reviewer severity model implicit.
portions.necessity: Implicit severity recreated low-value blocking loops.

portions.purpose: Inject macro-impact control into the Portuguese adversarial reviewer.
portions.objective: Assess only critical/high findings before blocking execution.
portions.simpler_alternative: Leave the reviewer severity model implicit.
portions.necessity: Both locales must enforce the same blocker policy.

portions.purpose: Apply macro-impact control before English planning questions.
portions.objective: Ask only decisions that materially change the graph.
portions.simpler_alternative: Ask every unresolved detail.
portions.necessity: Unfiltered clarification was a direct source of irrelevant delays.

portions.purpose: Apply macro-impact control before Portuguese planning questions.
portions.objective: Ask only decisions that materially change the graph.
portions.simpler_alternative: Ask every unresolved detail.
portions.necessity: Both locales must suppress low-impact questions.

portions.purpose: Define independent quality review under the macro-objective model.
portions.objective: Catch correctness risks without turning style nits into blockers.
portions.simpler_alternative: Use generic unscored code review.
portions.necessity: The Council requires independent quality with the same disposition rules.

portions.purpose: Define bounded simplification and line-necessity accounting.
portions.objective: Remove overengineering while preserving proven behavior.
portions.simpler_alternative: Use raw line count as a verdict.
portions.necessity: The user requires every retained portion to have a proven function.

portions.purpose: Define minimal vertical slices, validation and immediate local commits.
portions.objective: Make incremental implementation the governing execution skill.
portions.simpler_alternative: Implement an entire phase before validation.
portions.necessity: Large batches hide regressions and violate the requested local-commit cadence.

portions.purpose: Define one-at-a-time, impact-gated objective discovery.
portions.objective: Resolve only questions that materially unblock start-to-goal flow.
outputs: one material question or stop decision
portions.simpler_alternative: Ask a broad questionnaire.
portions.necessity: Broad interviews create the low-value iteration the upgrade targets.

portions.purpose: Define directed graph planning before each phase and item.
portions.objective: Make all required middle nodes and acceptance tests explicit.
outputs: edge-bound preflight with three test classes
portions.simpler_alternative: Use an unstructured checklist.
portions.necessity: A checklist cannot prove branch reachability or edge-level acceptance.

portions.purpose: Define graph-bound functional, quality and regression tests.
portions.objective: Create deterministic acceptance before implementation.
portions.simpler_alternative: Run a generic suite after coding.
portions.necessity: Generic green output does not prove the planned edge.

portions.purpose: Describe the English macro graph, lifecycle and incremental review loop.
portions.objective: Expose the same executable Council workflow to English projects.
portions.simpler_alternative: Maintain a disconnected English summary.
portions.necessity: Invalid lifecycle vocabulary previously broke the English path.

portions.purpose: Specify English planning and adversarial correction handoffs.
portions.objective: Keep review corrections traceable to plan, validation and fresh commit.
portions.simpler_alternative: Let reviewers edit directly.
portions.necessity: Independent reviewers must accuse and re-verify, not implement.

portions.purpose: Specify English completion, evidence and remote-authority rules.
portions.objective: Finish with proven delivery and no unauthorized push or main merge.
portions.simpler_alternative: Treat all Git actions as one permission.
portions.necessity: Local commits, push and remote-main merge have distinct authority.

portions.purpose: Inject the Portuguese macro-objective and graph contract.
portions.objective: Make the user goal the controlling north of every gate.
portions.simpler_alternative: Keep severity guidance dispersed across sections.
portions.necessity: One shared contract prevents conflicting blocker rules.

portions.purpose: Specify Portuguese lifecycle, phase/item planning and incremental slices.
portions.objective: Bind every edit to a graph edge, tests and local commit.
portions.simpler_alternative: Describe execution as an unordered checklist.
portions.necessity: Ordering is required to prevent pre-plan edits and unvalidated commits.

portions.purpose: Specify Portuguese quality, simplification and planning-review closure.
portions.objective: Close only exact terminal review verdicts and replan material gaps.
portions.simpler_alternative: Treat any review artifact as approval.
portions.necessity: A historical CORRIGIR file previously satisfied the graph evidence check.

portions.purpose: Specify Portuguese adversarial correction, proof and remote delivery.
portions.objective: Re-verify critical fixes and publish only with explicit authority.
outputs: satisfied delivery or explicit pending state
portions.simpler_alternative: Close after the first review or direct push.
portions.necessity: Corrections need fresh evidence and remote actions need separate consent.

portions.purpose: Define English weighted impact, structured evidence and excessive-gate policy.
portions.objective: Keep every operating skill aligned to the same macro severity model.
portions.simpler_alternative: Duplicate the scoring rules in each skill.
portions.necessity: Duplication would drift across reviewers and locales.

portions.purpose: Define Portuguese weighted impact, structured evidence and excessive-gate policy.
portions.objective: Keep every operating skill aligned to the same macro severity model.
portions.simpler_alternative: Duplicate the scoring rules in each skill.
portions.necessity: The Portuguese path must enforce the same evidence semantics.

portions.purpose: Bind English completion proof to all three test classes.
portions.objective: Reject completion based on narrative or a single happy path.
portions.simpler_alternative: Report green status without test-class reconciliation.
portions.necessity: Functional, quality and regression evidence answer different claims.

portions.purpose: Bind Portuguese completion proof to all three test classes.
portions.objective: Reject completion based on narrative or a single happy path.
portions.simpler_alternative: Report green status without test-class reconciliation.
portions.necessity: Both locales need the same completion threshold.

portions.purpose: Define English point-fix verification against graph-bound acceptance.
portions.objective: Prove each local correction before it can enter delivery.
portions.simpler_alternative: Trust the implementation claim.
portions.necessity: Correction prose cannot substitute for executed regression proof.

portions.purpose: Define Portuguese point-fix verification against graph-bound acceptance.
portions.objective: Prove each local correction before it can enter delivery.
portions.simpler_alternative: Trust the implementation claim.
portions.necessity: Both locales need executed correction proof.

portions.purpose: Load safe evidence, bind phase/review data to the graph and resolve semantic markers.
portions.objective: Reject fabricated nodes, prose-only findings and negative review artifacts.
portions.simpler_alternative: Check only path existence.
portions.necessity: Path existence accepted CORRIGIR as satisfied and ignored marker content.

portions.purpose: Detect executable commits, replay commands/events and verify repository integrity.
portions.objective: Prove delivery history and leave the checkout unchanged.
portions.simpler_alternative: Trust manifest commits and command exit codes.
portions.necessity: That alternative missed template commits and successful commands with side effects.

portions.purpose: Cross-check manifest acceptance, reviewers, critical edges, tests and evidence.
portions.objective: Bind final delivery to every planned and committed critical transition.
portions.simpler_alternative: Validate schemas independently.
portions.necessity: Schema-valid artifacts can still disagree semantically.

portions.purpose: Include every governing and review skill in Codex parity checks.
portions.objective: Keep Codex-only generation on the complete Council path.
portions.simpler_alternative: Test only the Council wrapper.
portions.necessity: A wrapper can reference skills that were never rendered.

portions.purpose: Regress locale vocabulary and integrated execution/authority contracts.
portions.objective: Prevent source-template drift from making documented commands invalid.
portions.simpler_alternative: Snapshot entire Markdown outputs.
portions.necessity: Focused markers localize contract drift such as APPLY versus APLICAR.

portions.purpose: Render a real project and execute every installed Council suite.
portions.objective: Prove source changes survive Copier and work in delivered runtime paths.
outputs: installed objective, runtime, pipeline, contract and scenario verdicts
portions.simpler_alternative: Run tests only against source paths.
portions.necessity: Source-only execution previously hid render and installation failures.

portions.purpose: Render and compare operating skills in Claude-only, Codex-only and dual modes.
portions.objective: Deliver one Council behavior across runtimes and locales.
portions.simpler_alternative: Compare only source Jinja files.
portions.necessity: Conditional render paths are observable only in generated projects.

portions.purpose: Render quality review into Claude projects.
portions.objective: Install the independent quality role on Claude runtime path.
portions.simpler_alternative: Reference an absent role.
portions.necessity: Claude and Codex must expose equivalent Council operators.

portions.purpose: Render simplification into Claude projects.
portions.objective: Install the final necessity-review role on Claude runtime path.
portions.simpler_alternative: Reference an absent role.
portions.necessity: The simplification gate must be callable in Claude projects.

portions.purpose: Render incremental execution into Claude projects.
portions.objective: Install the governing execution role on Claude runtime path.
portions.simpler_alternative: Leave execution rules only in Council prose.
portions.necessity: The user explicitly requires this skill to orient execution.

portions.purpose: Render objective-focused interview into Claude projects.
portions.objective: Install impact-gated discovery on Claude runtime path.
portions.simpler_alternative: Use generic questioning behavior.
portions.necessity: The Council must suppress low-impact questions in both runtimes.

portions.purpose: Render mandatory planning into Claude projects.
portions.objective: Install graph-bound phase/item preflight on Claude runtime path.
portions.simpler_alternative: Inline repeated planning rules.
portions.necessity: One source prevents runtime planning drift.

portions.purpose: Render graph-bound TDD into Claude projects.
portions.objective: Install deterministic acceptance authoring on Claude runtime path.

portions.necessity: Every planned edge needs explicit functional, quality and regression tests.
